Tomato Early Blight.symptoms: Dark concentric brown rings ("target-board" spots) primarily on older lower leaves, progressive yellowing, leaf defoliation.
Tomato Early Blight.organic_treatment: Apply Copper Hydroxide spray; prune lower foliage to improve air circulation; apply neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%).
Tomato Early Blight.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L spray at 10-14 day intervals.
Tomato Early Blight.prevention: Adopt drip irrigation to keep canopy dry; maintain 2-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceae family.

Tomato Late Blight.symptoms: Large irregular water-soaked pale-green lesions turning dark brown/black; white fungal bloom on underside during humid mornings.
Tomato Late Blight.organic_treatment: Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide soil/foliar application; remove and destroy infected plant debris immediately.
Tomato Late Blight.chemical_treatment: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L.
Tomato Late Blight.prevention: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; space plants 60 cm apart; plant resistant hybrid varieties.

Tomato Healthy.symptoms: Uniform deep green leaves, turgid foliage, robust petiole architecture without necrotic lesions.
Tomato Healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain balanced vermicompost and biofertilizer (Azotobacter + PSB) applications.
Tomato Healthy.chemical_treatment: No fungicide needed. Routine micronutrient spray (Zinc + Boron 0.2%) during flowering.
Tomato Healthy.prevention: Regular weekly field scouting and balanced NPK fertigation.

Potato Early Blight.symptoms: Small brown circular spots with concentric rings expanding on foliage; leaf margins curl upward.
Potato Early Blight.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) spray; mulching with paddy straw to prevent spore splash from soil.
Potato Early Blight.chemical_treatment: Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5 ml/L.
Potato Early Blight.prevention: Use certified pathogen-free seed tubers; destroy solanaceous weed hosts.

Potato Late Blight.symptoms: Rapid water-soaked lesions on leaf tips turning purplish-brown; sudden blighting of entire field in cool wet weather.
Potato Late Blight.organic_treatment: Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L; eradicate initial focus plants.
Potato Late Blight.chemical_treatment: Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Fenamidone + Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L.
Potato Late Blight.prevention: Strict preventive spraying upon forecast of cool foggy weather (>90% humidity, 15-22 C).

Corn Common Rust.symptoms: Golden-brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered across both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Corn Common Rust.organic_treatment: Foliar application of Bacillus subtilis culture; burn severely rusted residue post-harvest.
Corn Common Rust.chemical_treatment: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.25 ml/L.
Corn Common Rust.prevention: Sow early in the season to evade peak airborne spore flights; plant rust-tolerant hybrids.

Apple Scab.symptoms: Olive-green velvety fungal spots that become corky, scab-like, and puckered on leaves and young fruitlets.
Apple Scab.organic_treatment: Lime sulfur dormant spray; raking and composting fallen orchard leaves to eliminate overwintering ascospores.
Apple Scab.chemical_treatment: Captan 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Dithianon 70% WG @ 1 g/L at green-tip bud stage.
Apple Scab.prevention: Prune trees to open canopy to sunlight; select resistant cultivars.
